aliases: microgrids Microgrid voltage and reactive-power controls
summary: Restrains the selected control calculation when required measurement data becomes invalid.
description: Restrains the selected control calculation when required measurement data becomes invalid. Voltage and reactive-power control coordinate the AC operating condition of the microgrid resources. A voltage target, reactive-power target and power-factor target represent different control objectives and should have explicit ownership.

In an islanded microgrid, the assigned reference source supports bus voltage while other compatible resources share reactive demand according to the selected control method. Grid-connected operation can use a different objective at the PCC. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Measurement quality flags” at the input and “Reactive-control validity state” at the output. Fallback targets require explicit definition.
